recentItems.title: గ్రూప్-1 మూల్యాంకనం అక్రమాలపై ED దాడులు.. 7 చోట్ల ఏకకాలంలో సోదాలు!
recentItems.description:
The Enforcement Directorate (ED) has conducted simultaneous searches at seven locations in connection with alleged irregularities in the Group-1 examination evaluation process during the previous YCP government in Andhra Pradesh. The searches reportedly cover former APPSC Secretary PSR Anjaneyulu, CamSain Media and other private organisations. The agency is examining financial transactions and possible links between the organisations involved. The investigation is also looking into a possible money laundering angle related to the evaluation of Group-1 answer scripts. The searches may bring fresh details to light as the ED examines the financial trail and other evidence. The allegations are under investigation, and further details are awaited.

recentItems.title: 50 ఏళ్లలో రికార్డు వర్షాలు | Heavy Rains and 'Musuru Cyclone' Flood in East Godavari District
recentItems.description:
Unrelenting heavy rains triggered by the 'Musuru Cyclone' have severely affected Gopalapuram, Devarapalli, and Nallajarla mandals in East Godavari district, submerging several villages and cutting off transportation. Panic-stricken residents stated that they have not witnessed such unprecedented rainfall in the last 50 years. Communication routes between key villages and streams in the Gopalapuram mandal—including Kovvurapadu, Dondapudi, Gopalapuram, Vadakulanta, Karicherlagudem, and Chityala routes—have come to a complete standstill.
#HeavyWaterFlowInEastGodavari #CarFloatingInFlood #ETVDigital

recentItems.title: మురసు తుపానుతో గుంటూరు రైతులకు కన్నీళ్లే.. వేల ఎకరాల్లో పంట నష్టం
recentItems.description:
Cyclone Murasu has caused extensive agricultural damage across the erstwhile Guntur district, leaving farmers in distress. Swollen streams and overflowing waterways, along with breaches in the Nallamada Drain and several other channels, have flooded thousands of acres of agricultural land. Standing crops are submerged under several feet of water, with paddy, commercial crops and vegetables suffering significant damage. Farmers are facing heavy losses as floodwaters continue to inundate their fields. In NTR district, swollen streams have disrupted road connectivity, bringing movement between some villages to a standstill. The impact of the cyclone has severely affected both farming activities and normal life in the region.

recentItems.description:
Heavy rainfall has caused severe waterlogging in Kakinada and Rajamahendravaram in the erstwhile East Godavari district. Kakinada recorded around 12 cm of rainfall, leaving several streets, major roads and the bus stand submerged in knee-deep water. An ROB was also partially submerged, disrupting traffic. Rajamahendravaram received more than 11 cm of continuous rainfall, flooding key roads near Shambhonagar Rythu Bazaar and the railway station. Blocked drainage systems near the railway station and ROB worsened the situation, with even water-removal pumps getting submerged.

Indian-origin leaders have delivered mixed results in the US midterm elections, with several prominent Democratic representatives retaining their seats while some candidates faced defeat. Senior Democratic lawmakers Ami Bera, Ro Khanna, Suhas Subramanyam and Pramila Jayapal successfully held on to their positions. Piya Dandia made her first entry into the US Congress from Florida, marking a significant milestone. Meanwhile, Republican leader Vivek Ramaswamy, who was backed by former President Donald Trump and contested the Ohio gubernatorial election, suffered a defeat. The results highlight the growing political presence of Indian Americans in the United States, while also reflecting the mixed electoral fortunes of candidates of Indian origin.

recentItems.title: కొఠియా గిరిజనుల ఓటు హక్కును అడ్డుకుంటున్న ఒడిశా అధికారులు | మంత్రి సంధ్యారాణి
recentItems.description:
Andhra Pradesh Tribal Welfare Minister Sandhyarani has expressed strong concern over the alleged interference by Odisha officials in the democratic rights of tribal communities in the Kotia villages. She alleged that tribal residents were being intimidated and candidates were being threatened with demands to boycott the Parishad elections. Questioning the reported seizure of vehicles belonging to tribal residents, the minister asked why such measures were being taken when people wanted to exercise their voting rights. She also criticized officials for allegedly creating difficulties for residents of 29 tribal villages. Minister Sandhyarani assured the Kotia tribal communities that the Andhra Pradesh government would stand by them and support the protection of their democratic rights.
